neighbours.label: sequencing or discourse word opening a new sentence (Lastly, Well, Additionally, Furthermore)
fire: The wings are pale and narrow. Lastly, the tail has a dark band.
The method saves time on small jobs. Lastly, it needs no special tools.
We reviewed the budget and the hiring plan. Lastly, we set a date.
I was sure we had lost. Well, after the break, things turned around.
Nobody expected much from the sequel. Well, it turned out to be fun.
The engine is light and quiet. Additionally, it burns very little oil.
The school added two new classrooms. Additionally, the gym was repainted.
The sample was large and varied. Furthermore, the follow-up lasted a decade.
quiet: The wings are pale and narrow. The tail has a dark band.
The method saves time on small jobs and it needs no special tools.
We reviewed the budget and the hiring plan, and lastly we set a date.
I was sure we had lost. After the break, things turned around.
Nobody expected much from the sequel. It turned out to be fun.
The engine is light and quiet. It burns very little oil.
The school added two new classrooms, and additionally the gym was repainted.
The sample was large and varied. The follow-up lasted a decade.

predictions: 5/8 fire; the same sentences without the opener, or with it mid-sentence, stay quiet
notes: Card: ' Well' x12, ' Lastly' x3, ' How' x3. Probe: Lastly 0.68, Well 0.44, Furthermore 0.22; 'However' 0.04 (so not every connective), mid-sentence 'furthermore' 0.07.
